country: # Not web-verified: well-known spots from general knowledge
region: pinned with OSM kite / beach features.

name: Løkken
notes: North Sea beach, waves and side-shore wind; intermediate riders. Keep clear of bathers in summer.

name: Klitmøller
notes: Cold Hawaii: reef and beach breaks, experienced wave riders only. Rocks and strong currents.

name: Nørre Vorupør
notes: Wave spot either side of the fishing landing and its pier; experienced riders. Bathing zone in summer.

name: Agger Tange
notes: North Sea side of the Agger Tange spit: waves and current, experienced riders. Bird reserve on the spit, follow the signs.

name: Krik Vig
notes: Shallow flat-water bay of the Limfjord behind Agger, good for learning and freestyle. Launch at Krik.

name: Hvide Sande
notes: North Sea side (Nordstrand): waves and currents near the harbour, experienced riders. Ringkøbing Fjord side (by the surf centres north of town): shallow flat water, schools and beginners.

name: Bork Havn
notes: South end of Ringkøbing Fjord: shallow, flat brackish water, standing depth far out. Kite schools; very beginner-friendly.

name: Fanø – Rindby
notes: Very wide, flat sand beach; shallow sandbars and lagoons at lower tide. Reached by ferry from Esbjerg.

name: Rømø – Lakolk
notes: Huge flat sand beach with car access; shallow water and lagoons, sandbars at low tide. Kite zone signposted.

name: Rømø – Sønderstrand
notes: Southern Rømø beach with the kite and landkite zone; shallow, flat between the sandbars.

name: Sønderby
notes: Shallow flat water near Juelsminde, standing depth far out; popular for learning and freestyle.

name: Hejlsminde
notes: Lillebælt: shallow flat water inside the bay, chop further out; good for beginners.

name: Sjællands Odde
notes: Sejerø Bugt side of the Odde peninsula: shallow sandy water, chop to small waves.

name: Copenhagen – Amager Strandpark
notes: Artificial island beach with a shallow lagoon behind it. Kiting on the sea side outside the bathing zones; city spot, crowded in summer.
